# Server Operations Manual

Page 1
Section 1.1: System Architecture
The Acme Cloud Platform runs on a distributed architecture across three availability zones.
Each zone contains redundant load balancers and database replicas. Primary storage uses
high-performance SSD arrays with continuous snapshotting enabled.

Page 2
Section 1.2: Backup Procedures
Backups execute nightly at 02:00 UTC. The backup retention policy requires 30 daily snapshots,
12 monthly archives, and 7 annual archives. All backup archives are encrypted using AES-256-GCM.
In the event of secondary failure, disaster recovery failover completes in under 15 minutes (RTO = 15m, RPO = 5m).

Page 3
Section 1.3: Maintenance and Incident Response
Scheduled maintenance windows occur every Tuesday between 03:00 UTC and 05:00 UTC.
P1 critical incidents require response within 15 minutes by the on-call Site Reliability Engineer.
All incident post-mortems must be published to the engineering wiki within 48 hours of resolution.
